title: Integrating and Characterizing HPC Task Runtime Systems for hybrid AI-HPC workloads
problem: Hybrid AI-HPC workflows bottlenecked by Slurm srun throughput; srun unsuitable for dynamic heterogeneous tasks
motivation: Scientific workflows mix MPI/training/inference; throughput limited to 152 tasks/s; need better runtime systems
method: RADICAL-Pilot integrated with Flux and Dragon runtime systems; hierarchical resource management
key_novelty: RP+Flux+Dragon integration; 1500+ tasks/s throughput; 30-60% makespan reduction vs Slurm on real workloads
contributions: RADICAL-Pilot integration with Flux and Dragon
